claims.notes: JMA does publish normals for the AMeDAS station 礼文 (block_no=1546) on the island: 2003–2020, 18 years. Its averages: June 12.8℃ (high 15.9, low 10.3); July 17.3 (20.4/14.9); August 19.7 (22.6/17.3); October 11.2 (13.9/8.4); January −4.6 (−2.7/−6.5). The station 船泊 (1207) closed in 2003. Correct the text to say an island station exists (with a shorter 2003–2020 period), or use the 礼文 normals.

claims.notes: 「22℃ 左右」 is right (22.3). 「比台北的冬天還涼」 is wrong. Taipei's winter (Dec–Feb) mean temperature is about 16℃ (Taipei City Government statistics give January 16.2℃ and February 16.6℃ for 民國84–93), and its mean daily high is about 19–20℃. A Wakkanai August mean of 19.5℃ and mean high of 22.3℃ are warmer, not cooler. The article cites no Taiwanese source. Delete the comparison or compare with another season.

claims.sourceTitle: ご予約について | ハートランドフェリー
claims.sourceQuote: 2等客室に乗船される方 ご乗船手続は、出港時間の30~40分前までにお済ませください。… 1等客室 … 特別室及び2等指定席に乗船される方 ご乗船手続は、出港時間の20分前までにお済ませください。
claims.notes: Arithmetic: the bus gets back at 16:40 and the ferry leaves at 17:10, a 30-minute gap at the same terminal. Whether you make it depends on ticket class. For 2等 the check-in deadline is 16:30–16:40 (30–40 minutes before), or 16:30 under the FAQ's 40-minute rule, so it is a miss or at best borderline. For 1等 the deadline is 20 minutes before (16:50), so the connection works. The flat statement 「接不上」 is wrong as written. State the condition and reason, for example 「搭 2 等的話，趕不上開船前 30～40 分鐘的報到時限」.

claims.notes: Fetched live 2026-10-16 over http:// (HTTP 200; the site has no working HTTPS — TLS handshake fails). sourceUrl is written with https:// only because the validator requires it; the working URL is the http:// form. Grammatically natural and matches the Chinese. Soya Bus asks you to tell the driver as you approach the spot. 「この先で降ります」 or 「ここで降ろしてください」 is a more practical and polite request while the bus is moving. Consider changing it.

The ferry opens bookings on the same day two months before. The tour-bus page says 「２か月前から」 without specifying 同日, which is close enough.

claims.articleExcerpt: 夏天：搭 06:30 從稚內出發、08:25 到香深的船，回程搭 17:10（19:05 到稚內），島上約有 8 個半小時。

claims.notes: Arithmetic: 08:25 arrival to 17:10 departure is 8 hours 45 minutes, not 「約 8 個半小時」. Minus the 2等 check-in deadline (30–40 minutes before), usable time is about 8h05–8h15. Write 「約 8 小時 45 分（扣掉報到約 8 小時出頭）」.

claims.articleExcerpt: 冬天：時刻相近，但觀光巴士停駛、步道封閉。／（冬天）步道從 10 月下旬封閉
claims.sourceTitle: 礼文島トレイル【公式コース案内】
claims.sourceQuote: 10月1日より礼文滝コースが冬期閉鎖となります。なお、礼文林道コースを除くその他のコースに関しましては、10月20日より冬期閉鎖となります。
claims.notes: Too broad. The official notice excludes 礼文林道コース from the winter closure, and 礼文滝コース closes earlier, on 10/1. The FAQ answer and the day-trip line say all trails close (from late October). The detailed bullet earlier in the article is correct. Make the FAQ consistent with it, for example 「除礼文林道外，步道 10/20 起封閉」. Ferry times for winter (06:35→08:30, 17:05) and the tour-bus suspension are correct.
